title: The Semester of Cedar Falls
author: L. M. Almeida
blurb: Paloma Voss, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
